svg.title: From conventional distillation to DICE
svg.desc: Conceptual method comparison: conventional teacher development and subsequent student distillation above, coupled DICE development below. The broad downward arrow denotes a change in method organisation, not a transfer of data between workflow nodes. Shared colours are qualitative cost classes.
